metadata.title: World Digest — November 5, 2026
metadata.summary: Democrats swept the midterms, sending stocks soaring on bets of slower AI spending while gold held above $4,100 and oil plunged below $90 amid fresh Iran war fears.

sections.title: Political News
sections.content:
U.S. Midterms Reshape Washington

Democrats won control of Congress, with Hakeem Jeffries launching a bid to become the first Black House speaker Axios and Abdul El-Sayed’s Senate victory resonating with Muslim Americans AP News. Melat Kiros became the first Gen Z woman elected to Congress Democracy Now!. The shift creates headaches for Fed Chair Kevin Warsh Forex Factory and raises questions for Iran, Gaza, and Ukraine policy Al Jazeera.

Global Turmoil

Hong Kong activist Joshua Wong received an additional 10-year sentence The Hill. Russia agreed to supply Iran with 90 helicopter missile launchers Financial Times, while a Russian attack on a Ukrainian aid center may have killed 70 CBS News. Indonesia deployed 20,000 troops amid a wiretap scandal Bloomberg.com.

sections.title: Financial News
sections.content:
Global Markets

  • U.S. jobless claims slid to 189,000, the fewest since mid-July WSJ.
  • Gold held above $4,100 after Democrats swept the midterms, with a softer dollar and lower yields Barron's.
  • Oil prices plunged on Vance's Iran war post, then rebounded above $90 Axios.
  • Rheinmetall shares plunged 17% after a second guidance cut on military contract delays CNBC.

Equities

  • Qualcomm fell 9% despite beating Q4 estimates, as Q1 outlook disappointed Yahoo Finance.
  • Lumentum sank 15% after Marvell's offer, raising alternate bid speculation The Information.
  • Trump Media hit a record low; tech stocks soared on bets Democrats will slow AI spending The New York Times CNBC.

Corporate

  • CVS announced a major breakup; shares fell 10% Fox Business.
  • China blocked SoftBank's $5.4 billion ABB robotics takeover Reuters.
  • Sony profits surged on Spider-Man and PlayStation performance The Verge.

sections.title: Entertainment News
sections.content:
Entertainment

Bob Dylan met Pope Leo XIV at the Vatican, a historic intersection of music and faith KSL. Meanwhile, the industry mourned Patrick Stewart, with tributes highlighting his iconic Jean-Luc Picard TVLine. In box office news, 'Godzilla Minus Zero' eyes a $60M global opening while 'Ramayana' launches huge Deadline. Also, NewJeans' contracts reveal exploitative K-Pop practices, sparking industry scrutiny The New York Times.

sections.title: Sports
sections.content:
Football

Mariners introduce first-time manager Jason Kanzler ESPN. Albert Pujols is expected to interview for the Astros' managerial vacancy ESPN, while the Athletics hired Brewers' Cam Castro as GM ESPN. Mark Teixeira won a U.S. House seat ESPN.

Basketball

San Antonio Spurs 112, Dallas Mavericks 111 — Wembanyama posts career highs of 52 points and 24 rebounds ESPN. Denver Nuggets 128, Toronto Raptors 109 — Jokic's third triple-double powers the win ESPN. Portland Trail Blazers 132, Phoenix Suns 119 — Lillard and Clingan lead a fifth straight road win ESPN. Philadelphia 76ers 112, Detroit Pistons 106 — Jaylen Brown scores a season-high 30 ESPN.

Hockey

Los Angeles Kings 7, San Jose Sharks 2 — Adrian Kempe records a hat trick ESPN. Ottawa Senators 2, Buffalo Sabres 1 — Amadio scores late ESPN.

sections.title: Stock Analysis
sections.content:
IPOs

Upcoming listings include Hilton Worldwide (HLT) on Nasdaq Nov 5 Yahoo Finance, Leader's Advantage Acquisition (LEDR) and Deep Sea Minerals (SEAM) on Nasdaq Nov 6 Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance, and Haymaker Acquisition Corp V (HYAC) on NYSE Nov 9 Yahoo Finance. OPay (OPAY) recently priced at $19 on NYSE Oct 30 Yahoo Finance.

Major Indices

Stocks rallied sharply: Dow +3.03% to 53,356.12 Yahoo Finance, S&P 500 +1.58% to 7,688.62 Yahoo Finance, Nasdaq +1.44% Yahoo Finance, Russell 2000 +1.58% Yahoo Finance. VIX plunged 20.26% to 16.61 Yahoo Finance.

Sectors

Consumer Discretionary led (+4.26%) Yahoo Finance, followed by Financials (+3.51%) and Communication Services (+3.47%) Yahoo Finance. Energy lagged sharply (-4.74%) Yahoo Finance; Industrials fell 1.09% Yahoo Finance, Tech flat Yahoo Finance.

Major Stocks

Big tech gains: Microsoft +6.68% Yahoo Finance, Amazon +6.12% Yahoo Finance, Apple +5.31% Yahoo Finance. Nvidia fell 3.17% Yahoo Finance, Tesla -3.34% Yahoo Finance.

Notable Movers

Notable strength in mega-caps underscored broad risk-on tone Yahoo Finance.

Rates & Commodities

10-year yield dropped to 4.89% (-1.17%) Yahoo Finance. WTI crude plunged 8.29% to $88.12 Yahoo Finance. Gold jumped 3.37% to $4,073 Yahoo Finance; Bitcoin rose 3.96% to $80,405 Yahoo Finance.

sections.title: Outlook
sections.content:
Next 24–48 Hours - Democratic Congress signals policy shifts; watch for Fed Chair Warsh’s response to political pressure. - Oil volatility persists after Vance’s Iran comments; monitor for further supply disruptions.

Next Week - Hilton, Leader’s Advantage, Deep Sea Minerals IPOs debut — gauge risk appetite. - CVS breakup details and Rheinmetall guidance cuts may pressure healthcare/defense sectors.

Next Month - Jeffries’ speaker bid and Russia-Iran arms deal could reshape defense and Middle East policy. Expect continued market swings.

theme.name: Midterm Surge
theme.note: A blue wave lifts stocks and gold while oil plunges — a day of political victory and market euphoria.
